title: Obtain crystal structures
action: Download or obtain the published powder X-ray crystal structures of BaCu2Si2O7 and BaCu2Ge2O7 from Yamada et al. (2001) J. Solid State Chem. 156, 101. Parse lattice parameters, space group, and fractional atomic coordinates. Build the full crystal representation needed for periodic distance calculations.
description: Must load the structural data that defines all Cu–Cu distances and intermediate ion positions.

title: Compute magnetic exchange couplings
action: Implement the crystal-chemical method (cylinder model, Δh, l/l' asymmetry, direct-exchange term as described in the Approach). For each compound, identify the Cu–Cu pairs matching the specified coupling labels (J1–J8 for the silicate; J1, J2, J4 for the germanate). Compute all intermediate-ion contributions, sum them, add direct exchange when applicable, and write the final signed J^s values in Å⁻¹.
description: A JSON object with keys 'BaCu2Si2O7' and 'BaCu2Ge2O7'. Each maps coupling labels to their signed J^s values (Å⁻¹).
